open_gaps.title: لم يُشغّل المسار الحقيقي في حساب Google
open_gaps.reason: Approval, locking, Sheets schema, Calendar conflict handling and audit queue are proven only against a scripted fake (test-gas-simulated.js stubs UrlFetchApp). No live run has ever been recorded.
open_gaps.closure: Run the seven rehearsal steps in docs/go-live.md §3 (B-1…B-5) on a real account and fill scripts/rehearsal-checklist.json evidence fields.

open_gaps.title: إعدادات GitHub غير مفعّلة: 0 أسرار · 0 متغيّرات · main غير محمية
open_gaps.reason: gh api reports variables 0, secrets 0, branches/main.protected=false. The secrets manifest is declared policy, not enforced state. The agent session cannot read or create repository settings.
open_gaps.closure: Run sh scripts/bootstrap-github.sh on the owner's gh session (docs/secrets.md §7a-2). Note: zero secrets is the correct state for CI; what is missing is branch protection.

open_gaps.title: قاعدة المدد والساعات مكرّرة بين الواجهة والخادم
open_gaps.reason: app.js recomputes visit duration and busy spans; Code.gs does the same against Calendar. Today both agree (check-settings-parity proves 15 fields match), but the duplication is the defect: a future edit to one side diverges silently.
open_gaps.closure: Generate both sides from one shared fixture, or extend check-settings-parity to compare durations/busy spans across the two implementations.

open_gaps.title: جسر Google مُتحقَّق فقط ضد بديل مكتوب
open_gaps.reason: config/google.profile.json absent; the example profile has every layout id null. Drive/Sheets/Calendar paths are proven only against a fake, so scope and folder-visibility issues cannot surface here.
open_gaps.closure: Run docs/google-setup.md §2 steps 7–10 on the dev account, record the selftest output in scripts/rehearsal-checklist.json.

silent_gates.why: The only place that compares declared secrets/variables against real repository settings. It is the reporter for U3 and G2, and it cannot fail: a run that detects an empty, drifted or missing configuration still reports success. It has been green by construction.
silent_gates.fix: Run it twice: the report step with output captured, then a verdict step that fails with an annotation naming what is missing. Keep the schedule non-blocking only for names that are correctly absent (zero secrets is valid); fail on drift from the manifest.

silent_gates.why: If assets/ is ever renamed or empty, the deploy publishes a site with no fonts and no error. The self-containment guard greps for external CDNs but does not require local font files to exist.
silent_gates.fix: Copy without masking, and assert the expected font count in test-publish-contract.js.

silent_gates.why: Deliberate: the decision is taken from the JSON report, so a finding becomes an annotation instead of a bare exit code. It is only safe while the reporter itself runs — if the JSON parse throws, the node reporter does exit 1, but the || true would also swallow a crash in gitleaks that still left a stale /tmp/leaks.json from a previous step.
silent_gates.fix: Remove the stale-report risk by deleting /tmp/leaks.json before the scan, and add a negative test that feeds the reporter a non-empty report.

silent_gates.why: Seven live warnings are printed and exit 0: four declared-only secrets, two unreferenced variables, and a stale map commit. Declared-only is policy, but the map-staleness warning has been true for several commits and nothing acts on it.
silent_gates.fix: Promote the map-staleness warning to an error (the map must be refreshed on the commit that changes behaviour); keep declared-only warnings as warnings.

silent_gates.pattern: skip() → process.exit(0) when GEMINI_API_KEY is absent
silent_gates.why: The live provider probe reports success when it never ran, and CI shows a green check named «live LLM smoke (optional)». Acceptable only because the name says optional and the flag LLM_SMOKE_ENABLED turns a missing key into a failure.
silent_gates.fix: Print SKIPPED (explicit) and keep exit 0 (a fork PR cannot have the key), but make the job name derive from the outcome so a skip is never rendered as a pass.

silent_gates.why: Justified: a PR build must stay meaningful before a Pages site exists, and the next step turns a missing site into an explicit error.

not_a_gate: scripts/scan-secrets.js — its exit 0 paths are a clean scan and a --list mode; verified by reading both.
scripts/check-config.js, scripts/check-settings-parity.js — exit 0 only on a clean pass (0 warnings printed).
actionlint, gitleaks, jsdom suites, test-publish-contract.js — already fail loudly since PR #32; re-confirmed by injection in this round.
